recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#F5F5F5). 2. Add a red-bordered rectangle at the top containing the title 'Required to PENALIZE small values of Precision and Recall' in dark red (#8B0000), with 'PENALIZE' underlined in bright red (#FF0000). 3. Place a yellow circle (#FFFF00) at the top-right with black text '15'. 4. Add a blue-bordered white box on the middle-left with three lines: 'Remember:' in black; 'Ranges of Precision and Recall are from 0 to 1' with 'from 0 to 1' in red and underlined; 'Using 1/Precision and 1/Recall' with fractions in red. 5. Insert a graph on the middle-right: draw x and y axes with ticks from -5 to 5, plot the hyperbola y=1/x, label the curve 'y = 1/x', and add a yellow elliptical highlight with red boundary lines around the curve segment near the positive y-axis. 6. Add a large blue-bordered box across the bottom. 7. Inside it, first line: 'As Precision/Recall Decreases ⇒ Value of (1/Precision) and (1/Recall) Increases' with Precision/Recall/F1 in blue, Decreases/Increases in green, fractions in red. 8. Second line: 'Define: 1/F1 = 1/Precision + 1/Recall ⇒ F1 increases as both Precision and Recall are high values' with same color coding. 9. Third line: 'F1 Range is from 0 to 0.5 ⇒ Normalize' with '0 to 0.5' in red and 'Normalize' in green. 10. Add a peach-colored rounded rectangle (#FFDAB9) at the bottom-right containing the equation '1/F1 = 0.5 (1/Precision + 1/Recall)' with F1 in blue, 0.5 in red, and Precision/Recall in red.
